rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for lacking confidence in oneself or around other people.

example.english: I feel insecure when I see so many people.
example.traditional: 我一見到咁多人就冇自信。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 gin3 dou2 gam3 do1 jan4 zau6 mou5 zi6 seon3

rows.note: Use this when “insecure” mainly means uncomfortable or ill at ease in a particular social situation rather than lacking confidence generally.

example.english: I felt insecure all evening having dinner with people I was meeting for the first time.
example.traditional: 同第一次見面嘅人食飯，我成晚都覺得唔自在。
example.jyutping: tung4 dai6 jat1 ci3 gin3 min6 ge3 jan4 sik6 faan6 ngo5 seng4 maan5 dou1 gok3 dak1 m4 zi6 zoi6

rows.note: Use this when something is physically, technically, or otherwise not secure or safe.

example.english: The exposed wiring here is insecure.
example.traditional: 呢度啲電線咁樣露晒出嚟，好唔安全。
example.jyutping: nei1 dou6 di1 din6 sin3 gam2 joeng2 lou6 saai3 ceot1 lai4 hou2 m4 on1 cyun4
